date_note: Leak-site listing seen Nov 18; no intrusion date given.
title: The Gentlemen ransomware group lists Nvidia on its leak site
summary: The Gentlemen ransomware group listed Nvidia on its extortion site, with a countdown to November 28 and no proof of a breach shared (BleepingComputer); the listing was seen on November 18. A spokesperson told SecurityWeek and BleepingComputer that Nvidia is investigating an incident that may have affected a third-party partner and has found no indication its own systems or networks were affected.
plain: A ransomware gang says it hacked Nvidia. Nvidia says it found no sign its own systems were hit, but is investigating an incident at an outside partner.
exec: Unproven claim; Nvidia says its own systems were not affected and is checking a partner, so supplier exposure is possible.
action: No action needed; for awareness. Nvidia partners should watch for official statements and treat unsolicited messages about the claim with caution.

validation.note: IBTimes, Cyber Security News, BleepingComputer and SecurityWeek report the claim; Nvidia's statement (third-party partner incident, no indication its systems were affected) read in SecurityWeek and BleepingComputer. Still an unconfirmed claim. The Cybernews page was blocked.

review.note: Read SecurityWeek and BleepingComputer: statement, Nov 28 countdown, no proof match. Summary credited BleepingComputer with a Nov 18 listing date and no sample files; neither says so. Reworded; claimed and severity 1 kept
